title: Jorijn Schrijvershof (@jorijn@jorijn.com)
excerpt: Today, I’m letting you know that toot.community will close permanently on 28 October 2026. This decision is final, and the server won’t be handed over to anyone else. When I started running toot.community, I really enjoyed it. Over time, it became more stressful and less rewarding. Every day, I deal with spam, bots, technical issues, abuse reports, and user conflicts. Much of the moderation ends up being about personal disagreements rather than actual rule-breaking. More importantly, I don’t enjoy how people interact on social media anymore. Too often, conversations turn hostile or confrontational. A small amount of conflict and bad actors takes up a disproportionate amount of time and energy. I find myself feeling more angry or discouraged after spending time as an admin, and that’s not what I want from social media or a volunteer project. There’s also the financial side. I’m very grateful to everyone who donated, but donations haven’t covered costs for a long time. I’ve had to shoulder most of the expenses, time, and responsibility myself. The server is now closed to new registrations and will remain online until 28 October 2026, so you’ll have three months to find another Mastodon or Fediverse server and move your account. You can find Mastodon’s official migration guide here: https://docs.joinmastodon.org/user/moving/ Please note that Mastodon can move your followers, but it can’t transfer your old posts or uploaded media to your new account. If you want to keep a copy, download an archive. If you’d like to stay in touch, you can follow my personal account here (@jorijn).
content_html:
Today, I’m letting you know that toot.community will close permanently on 28 October 2026.

This decision is final, and the server won’t be handed over to anyone else.

When I started running toot.community, I really enjoyed it. Over time, it became more stressful and less rewarding.

Every day, I deal with spam, bots, technical issues, abuse reports, and user conflicts. Much of the moderation ends up being about personal disagreements rather than actual rule-breaking.

More importantly, I don’t enjoy how people interact on social media anymore. Too often, conversations turn hostile or confrontational. A small amount of conflict and bad actors takes up a disproportionate amount of time and energy.

I find myself feeling more angry or discouraged after spending time as an admin, and that’s not what I want from social media or a volunteer project.

There’s also the financial side. I’m very grateful to everyone who donated, but donations haven’t covered costs for a long time. I’ve had to shoulder most of the expenses, time, and responsibility myself.

The server is now closed to new registrations and will remain online until 28 October 2026, so you’ll have three months to find another Mastodon or Fediverse server and move your account.

You can find Mastodon’s official migration guide here: https://docs.joinmastodon.org/user/moving/

Please note that Mastodon can move your followers, but it can’t transfer your old posts or uploaded media to your new account. If you want to keep a copy, download an archive.

If you’d like to stay in touch, you can follow my personal account here (@jorijn).

content_html_zh:
今天，我通知您，toot.community 将于 2026 年 10 月 28 日永久关闭。

此决定是最终决定，服务器不会移交给其他任何人。

当我开始运行 toot.community 时，我真的很喜欢它。 随着时间的推移，压力越来越大，回报也越来越少。

我每天都会处理垃圾邮件、机器人、技术问题、滥用报告和用户冲突。 大部分的温和最终都是关于个人分歧，而不是实际的违规行为。

更重要的是，我不再喜欢人们在社交媒体上的互动方式。 很多时候，谈话会变得充满敌意或对抗性。 少量的冲突和不良行为者会占用不成比例的时间和精力。

在担任管理员一段时间后，我发现自己感到更加愤怒或沮丧，而这不是我想要从社交媒体或志愿者项目中得到的。

还有财务方面。 我非常感谢所有捐款的人，但捐款已经很长时间无法支付费用了。 我必须自己承担大部分费用、时间和责任。

该服务器现已停止接受新注册，并将保持在线状态直至 2026 年 10 月 28 日，因此您将有三个月的时间寻找另一个 Mastodon 或 Fediverse 服务器并移动您的帐户。

您可以在这里找到 Mastodon 的官方迁移指南：https://docs.joinmastodon.org/user/moving/

请注意，Mastodon 可以移动您的关注者，但无法将您的旧帖子或上传的媒体转移到您的新帐户。 如果您想保留副本，请下载存档。

如果您想保持联系，可以在这里关注我的个人帐户 (@jorijn)。
